title: Maximum Sync Queue Size Exceeded
symptom: User keeps getting a 'Maximum Sync Queue Size Exceeded' error message. Clearing xDrip data temporarily fixes it, but the error returns after a few weeks. When the queue size is exceeded, followers don't get any data.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. It is suggested that disabling background data access for xDrip might be related, but users report background data is enabled. Later, it is suggested that the error may be due to xDrip sync being enabled on the master when followers are using Nightscout follower, but the user reports the master is Diabox and they are only a follower.
fix: The thread suggests that if followers are using Nightscout follower, disabling xDrip sync on the master (deselecting 'Be master for followers') can stop the error. However, the user reports the master is Diabox, so this may not apply. The issue was closed after asking if it still occurs with the latest nightly, but no explicit resolution is confirmed.
evidence_quote: If your followers are using the Nightscout follower option, you can disable the xDrip sync on the master, which will stop getting the max sync queue size exceeded error. On the master, go to the following page: Settings -> xDrip+ Sync Settings, and deselect "Be master for followers".
